{{Quote|Today's post-match cleanup provided by Korrfun's All-Star Salky Kibble. Shouldn't your salky eat the best talent around? Now, back to the brawl!|Baron Deathmark|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Korrfun's All-Star Salky Kibble''' was a pet food company that produced food for [[Salky hound/Legends|salky hounds]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and sponsored [[Huttball/Legends|Huttball]] matches.
